spans.text: Atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirantaṁ viharitvā āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ āmantesi: When the Buddha had stayed in Rājagaha as long as he pleased, he addressed Venerable Ānanda, “āyāmānanda, yena ambalaṭṭhikā tenupasaṅkamissāmā”ti.

Atha kho bhagavā ambalaṭṭhikāyaṁ yathābhirantaṁ viharitvā āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ āmantesi: When the Buddha had stayed in Ambalaṭṭhikā as long as he pleased, he addressed Venerable Ānanda, “āyāmānanda, yena nāḷandā tenupasaṅkamissāmā”ti.
